hints.title: Reverse Target Simulation
hints.text: Work backwards from target to startValue. The operations invert: instead of multiply by 2 and subtract 1, divide by 2 and add 1.

hints.title: Parity-Based Operation Choice
hints.text: While target > startValue: if target is odd, you must add 1; if target is even, division by 2 is always optimal.

hints.title: Direct Excess Addition
hints.text: Loop while target > startValue: if target % 2 == 1, target += 1; else target //= 2; increment operations count. Once target <= startValue, add (startValue - target) to operations count and return.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Forward BFS explores an exponential branching state space up to 2^(steps), causing Time Limit Exceeded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Working backward is completely deterministic and halves target almost every other step, running in logarithmic time with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should justify why backward division is deterministic whereas forward multiplication has multiple non-obvious choices.
complexity.notes: When target becomes smaller than startValue, only addition (backward: subtracting 1) can close the gap.
